requiredBehaviors.behavior: justify the validation need before protocol design and choose an evidence model appropriate to the process
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow begins with an explicit validation-need decision and allows IQ/OQ/PQ or an alternative evidence pattern when justified by process risk and verifiability.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: define acceptance criteria parameter ranges worst cases sampling and measurement readiness before execution
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Validation Strategy and Protocol require parameter ranges, worst cases, sample rationale, measurement readiness and acceptance criteria before execution.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: force IQ OQ and PQ phases without checking whether they fit the process
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: IQ/OQ/PQ by purpose explicitly rejects a blind three-phase template for every process.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: choose acceptance criteria after seeing the execution data
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Predefined acceptance criteria explicitly prohibit post-hoc criteria.
